results.title: swoosh_v2
results.author: migoreng1
results.description: This swoosh sound is a short, descending-frequency effect designed to create a smooth and dynamic auditory cue. Built using a sine wave, ensuring a smooth, clean, and natural tonal quality without harsh or mechanical artifacts. Purpose and Feel: - The descending pitch creates a sense of completion, transition, or closure. - It can evoke a sense of speed or movement, making it ideal for UI animations (e.g., swiping, dismissing, or transitioning elements), sports visuals, or cinematic sound effects.
